MAGIC.description: The monster will trigger its effect when played on the board.

CHARGE.label: Charge
CHARGE.description: The monster can attack during its first turn. Overrides Haste. Removed after attacking or when your turn ends.

DUST.label: Dust
DUST.description: The monster will trigger its effect when dying.

PARALYZE.label: Paralyze
PARALYZE.description: Make a monster unable to attack for its next turn.

SWITCH.label: Switch
SWITCH.description: When this effect triggers, if this monster is on the left side of the board do the first effect, highlighted in blue. Otherwise, do the second effect, highlighted in red.

CATCH.label: Catch
CATCH.description: Remove a card and store a copy of it within this monster. The copy stored can be released to the original owner's board or elsewhere if specified.

HASTE.label: Haste
HASTE.description: The monster can attack once during its first turn, but can't attack the opponent. Removed after attacking or whenever a turn ends.

ERASE.label: Erase
ERASE.description: Remove a card. Cards removed this way are not sent to the dustpile.

GENERATED.label: Generated
GENERATED.description: Card that didn't start in the deck.

LOOP.label: Loop
LOOP.description: When you play this card while it has 1 or more Loop, add a copy of this to your hand with -1 Loop.

SYNERGY.label: Synergy
SYNERGY.description: The monster will trigger its effect when played and if an ally monster of the same tribe has been played this turn.

CANDY.label: Candy
CANDY.description: This monster will be healed by 3 at the end of its owner's turn.

DELAY.label: Delay
DELAY.description: The card will trigger this effect at the end of the turn it was played. It will trigger even if the card is killed or removed from the board before the turn ends.

TRANSPARENCY.label: Transparency
TRANSPARENCY.description: The monster can't be targeted. Takes priority over Taunt. Removed at the start of its owner's turn.

DODGE.label: Dodge
DODGE.description: This monster will negate any instance of damage to itself (x) times.

PROGRAM.label: Program
PROGRAM.description: If you have (x) Gold, spend it to trigger this effect.

SILENCE.label: Silence
SILENCE.description: Remove all status effects from a monster and make it unable to use its abilities.

KR.label: KR
KR.description: A death-linked debuff. When the affected monster dies, its killer gains +1/+1; if there's no killer, or the killer is gone by the end of the turn, a random enemy monster gets +1/+1 instead.

SUPPORT.label: Support
SUPPORT.description: This monster will trigger its effect before another ally monster attacks.

DARKSPAWN.label: Darkspawn
DARKSPAWN.description: This monster takes no damage from spells and cannot be targeted by them.

NEED.label: Need
NEED.description: This card's Magic effect can only trigger if the following condition is met. This monster will glow yellow in your hand while its condition is met.

TURBO.label: Turbo
TURBO.description: This card will trigger its effect when drawn.

INVULNERABLE.label: Invulnerable
INVULNERABLE.description: This entity is immune to all damage.

SHOCK.label: Shock
SHOCK.description: After you cast a spell with a base Cost of 2 or more, trigger this effect.

BULLSEYE.label: Bullseye
BULLSEYE.description: If this card kills a monster by bringing it to exactly 0 HP, trigger this effect.

WANTED.label: Wanted
WANTED.description: Wanted. Before this monster dies, give 1 Gold to its opponent.

QUEST.label: Quest
QUEST.description: This monster will start a quest at the start of the game.
